en-US.description: The open-source studio for making games with AI
en-US.longDescription:
OhMyGame puts everything you need to make games with AI in one app: describe your game, and the agent designs it, makes the assets, builds it, plays it to check it works, and publishes it to a link you can share. It is open source and works with 40+ model providers through Pi, from Anthropic and OpenAI to DeepSeek and Qwen. Your keys stay on your machine, there are no per-run credits, and what you make is yours.
Agent: drives the canvas, builds and plays the game. The agent drafts the design doc, lays out boards, and generates assets on them. Then it reads the design doc, writes the code, and runs the game in a live preview. It opens the game in a window you can watch and plays it, including real-time canvas and WebGL games. When it finds a problem, it tries a fix and plays again. Along the way it can generate images, video, and 3D models, search the web, and use MCP servers or the Codex and Claude Code plugins you already have.
Canvas: design docs, art, video, and 3D on one board. Every game project has a design space: a main design doc plus boards where the doc, images, video, and 3D models sit side by side. Nodes can use each other as references, so one character design can lead to more images, a video, or a rigged and animated 3D model. Results go into a shared Asset Library that your games can use.
Publish: one link, playable anywhere. Sign in and publish: OhMyGame builds your game and gives it a link anyone can play in the browser. Republishing updates the same link. Published games are listed in the in-app Community, where you can play what others have made.

en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- Add ElevenLabs for speech, sound effects, music and transcription, with your
  account's voices, Transcribe to text on an audio node, and the newer Sound
  Effects v3 and Music v2.5 models.
  (#748 by @dihuangdh,
  #768 by @idontcarethishahaha)
- Set default models for speech, sound effects and music, for every project or
  for one.
  (#756 by @dihuangdh)
- Add a pixel art fixer to Canvas images, which makes a clean pixel-art copy
  and leaves the source untouched.
  (#743 by @idontcarethishahaha)
- Sort Library and project assets by date, size or name, and filter them by
  when they were added or changed.
  (#742 by @dogxii)
- Keep the sidebar's projects in an order you choose: drag them, or use Alt
  with the arrow keys, and pick how many show. The section is now Quick access.
  (#745 by @dogxii)
- Let a General project without a web preview add the Game panel, and show a
  project's own panels in Code.
  (#733 by @dogxii)
- Add OhMyGame's own plugins from its @ohmygame npm scope.
  (#766 by @dogxii)
Changed
- Make audio one Canvas node and one agent tool for speech, sound effects and
  music, choose from compact controls under the node, and give the node the
  16:9 media shape. Existing boards open in the new form.
  (#748 by @dihuangdh,
  #752 by @dihuangdh,
  #749 by @dihuangdh,
  #768 by @idontcarethishahaha,
  #770 by @xinyang6879)
- Set up Doubao Speech as one provider for TTS 2.0 and Seed Audio, with one API
  key, switch and voice.
  (#751 by @dihuangdh,
  #755 by @dihuangdh)
- Show generated images, videos and 3D models as small thumbnails beside the
  tool calls that made them, instead of large previews after the reply.
  (#763 by @dihuangdh)
- Run Claude Code's media generation calls side by side, and label calls
  waiting behind a running one as queued.
  (#765 by @dihuangdh)
- Give each project action one home: one Project settings dialog for every
  project type, and Play in the top bar for interactive stories too.
  (#741 by @dogxii,
  #739 by @dihuangdh,
  #740 by @dihuangdh)
- Show Community pages you've seen at once while they refresh, with card
  skeletons and a loading screen while a game starts.
  (#746 by @dogxii)
- Show 3D preview controls only for models with animations, and play the clip
  without turning the model.
  (#762 by @dihuangdh)
- Point plugin and project $schema links at ohmygame.ai.
  (#729 by @dogxii)
Removed
- Remove the Three.js World and Image to Three.js plugins. The copy OhMyGame
  installed is uninstalled once.
  (#734 by @dogxii)
Fixed
- Offer a link to copy when the system can't open it, such as on Windows
  without a default browser, and ignore copies that fail because the window
  lost focus.
  (#758 by @dihuangdh)
- Start a conversation without a model on the one its picker shows.
  (#724 by @dogxii)
- Open a project's Canvas even when the project has its own design/ folder
  or canvas.json.
  (#761 by @dogxii)
- Ready the plugin author packages for npm, and list every part of a plugin
  when you review it before adding.
  (#731 by @dogxii)
- Fix spacing and colors in the AI workspace Overview, plugin lists, the audio
  panel in light mode and the media submenu.
  (#754 by @dogxii,
  #750 by @dihuangdh,
  #747 by @xinyang6879)

zh-CN.description: 用 AI 制作游戏的开源工作室
zh-CN.longDescription:
OhMyGame 把用 AI 制作游戏所需的一切放进一个应用：描述你的游戏，智能体会完成设计、生成素材、构建游戏、试玩验证，并把它发布成一个可以分享的链接。它是开源项目，通过 Pi 支持 40 多家模型服务商，从 Anthropic、OpenAI 到 DeepSeek、通义千问。密钥保存在你自己的机器上，没有按次计费，你做出的东西属于你。
智能体：驱动画布，构建并试玩游戏。智能体会起草设计文档、布置画板并在上面生成素材，然后阅读设计文档、编写代码，并在实时预览中运行游戏。它会在一个可见的窗口中打开游戏并进行试玩，包括实时画布和 WebGL 游戏。发现问题时，它会尝试修复并再次试玩。过程中它还可以生成图像、视频和 3D 模型，搜索网页，以及使用 MCP 服务器或你已有的 Codex、Claude Code 插件。
画布：设计文档、美术、视频和 3D 模型同板呈现。每个游戏项目都有一个设计空间：一份主设计文档，加上若干画板，文档、图像、视频和 3D 模型并排放置。节点之间可以相互引用，一个角色设计可以衍生出更多图像、一段视频或一个绑定好的 3D 模型。产出的成果进入共享素材库，供你的游戏使用。
发布：一个链接，随处可玩。登录并发布：OhMyGame 会构建你的游戏，并给出一个任何人都能在浏览器中打开的链接。重新发布会更新同一个链接。已发布的游戏会出现在应用内的社区中，你可以试玩别人制作的游戏。
